name: curtain-automation
description: Tuya curtain automation on GCP Cloud Functions

scripts.deploy: npm run build && gcloud functions deploy curtain-automation --gen2 --runtime=nodejs22 --region=us-central1 --source=. --entry-point=curtainAutomation --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --timeout=540s --memory=256Mi --set-secrets=TUYA_ACCESS_KEY=tuya-access-key:latest,TUYA_ACCESS_SECRET=tuya-access-secret:latest,TUYA_DEVICE_ID=tuya-device-id:latest,TUYA_REGION=tuya-region:latest
